colors.name: night-ground
colors.role: ground — the deep plum-black of a back-alley at 1 AM, the page behind the tent; never carries text on its own

colors.name: night-panel
colors.role: secondary surface — tent wall, menu card, raised panel; a lift of one step above the ground

colors.name: night-high
colors.role: hover/active surface — the rim of a glass, a hovered menu row, the lit tent stripe

colors.name: lantern-white
colors.role: primary text — the warm off-white of a lit paper lantern inside the tent (14.6:1 on night-ground, AAA)

colors.name: lantern-dim
colors.role: secondary text — Korean glosses, captions, the tent's quieter voice; lantern composited over night at ~70% (8.0:1 on night-ground, AAA)

colors.name: neon-amber
colors.role: the page accent — grill fire, the ! in 야식!, focus ring, ::selection ground, the price numerals. 9.4:1 on night-ground (AAA on normal text) — works as both accent and functional text

colors.name: neon-amber-bright
colors.role: neon at full draw / grill at full heat — large display and non-text only (the steam core, the SFX fill)

colors.name: neon-pink
colors.role: the second neon — the cold-drinks sign, the soju glass highlight, halftone dot fields; 5.0:1 on night-ground (AA on normal text), large/display and accent use

colors.name: soju-green
colors.role: the third neon — the soju bottle tone, the menu's vegetarian tag, the clink spark; 8.1:1 on night-ground (AAA), used sparingly as a辨识 chromatic pop

colors.name: steel
colors.role: metadata — chapter numerals, eyebrows, inactive menu rows, the steam's faint underglow (6.0:1 on night-ground, AA on normal text)

colors.name: hairline
colors.role: decorative rules — lantern-white at ~12% over night-ground; never carries text

fonts.role: Korean display — the wordmark 야식!, panel titles, SFX lettering; loud and flat, the cover of a webtoon chapter
Korean speech-bubble and caption voice — a handwriting face so the tent's banter reads as someone talking, not a label
the prose voice — every Korean body line, the menu, the hours; a modern Korean sans that holds its weight under neon
the machine + the ASCII neon — order tickets, prices, and the ASCII-art sign glyphs rendered in a monospace grid

texture: A three-layer back-alley night, all static. (1) Ground: a slow vertical gradient night-ground → night-panel holding the whole page like wet asphalt under a tent. (2) Halftone dots: a fixed CSS radial-gradient dot grid at ~7% lantern-white opacity (background-size 14px 14px, radial dot 1.5px) layered over the ground — the printed-webtoon Ben-Day dot that makes the page read as ink on newsprint, not a screen; never animated, mix-blend-mode: screen. (3) Neon haze: per-section faint radial blooms in amber/pink/green at 4–8% opacity, the bloom of bare bulbs through tent fabric. No feTurbulence (this is printed, not photographic); no grain film.

motion.name: ease-snack
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1) — entrances: a skewer slapped onto the grill, settling fast

motion.name: steam-scrub
motion.value: --ns-steam ∈ [0,1] driven by scroll progress through the cooking panel; 12 steam/halftone frames crossfade by opacity (only 3 ever visible) — the no-video video of food cooking

motion.name: neon-flicker
motion.value: 3.3s / 3.7s / 4.1s steps(1, end) infinite across two brightness dips per cycle — three signs, mutually prime, the buzz of overworked tent bulbs

motion.name: ascii-flicker
motion.value: the ASCII neon sign's text-shadow + opacity stepped every 3.3–4.1s; per-glyph opacity jitter on ~8% of cells so the sign reads as dying bulbs, not a fade

motion.name: clink-spring
motion.value: drag-released glasses coast on inertia (lerp 0.86 vel decay/frame), spring back to rest (stiffness 0.18, damping 0.78) — a clink is two glasses whose circles overlap, firing a pink/amber spark SFX

motion.name: panel-rise
motion.value: 800ms ease-snack, translateY(24px) → 0, 90ms stagger — panels rise into the frame like webtoon cuts

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 650ms ease-snack, translateY(16px) → 0, 70ms stagger per observer batch — section heads, menu, footer

motion.name: grill-breath
motion.value: the grill ember band breathes opacity 0.7 → 1.0 over 3.1s; the lantern row sways ±0.6° over 5.7s — mutually prime ambient
